panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status. Blank when nothing was served in the window.

panels.title: Templates — the bet this project makes
Share of lists created from a template
Routes — traffic, latency, errors
panels.description: Averaged over the whole dashboard time range, so it ranks routes rather than tracking spikes.

panels.title: CPU (share of one core)
panels.description: Seconds of CPU burned per second. 1 means one core saturated.

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: How long a callback waits before the loop gets to it. Rising lag means the process is CPU-bound.

panels.title: Heap trend
panels.description: Slope of used heap across the visible range. A sustained positive number is the shape a leak makes; the raw used/committed ratio is not, because V8 keeps the committed heap nearly full by design.

panels.title: Heap by space (used)
panels.description: A steadily growing old space with flat new space is the shape a leak makes.

panels.title: Time spent in GC
panels.description: Fraction of wall-clock time the process spends collecting. Anything sustained above a few percent is worth chasing.

panels.title: File descriptors
panels.description: The limit sits on its own axis — it is four orders of magnitude above the open count, so a shared axis would flatten the line that matters.

panels.title: Active handles by type
panels.description: Sockets that never close show up here first.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: Every container in the listryx compose project — api, postgres and keycloak — measured by cAdvisor, with no cooperation from the containers themselves. The dashed throttled series only appears for a container that declares a CPU limit.

panels.title: CPU load average (10s)
panels.description: Tasks waiting on CPU inside the container. Unlike the CFS counters this is reported whether or not a CPU limit is declared.

panels.title: Working set by container
panels.description: Every container in the listryx compose project — api, postgres and keycloak — measured by cAdvisor, with no cooperation from the containers themselves.

panels.title: Working set vs page cache
panels.description: The limit series only appears for containers that actually declare one.

panels.title: OOM kills and allocation failures
panels.description: Flat at zero is the healthy shape. Any bump here explains a restart.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Transmit is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Writes are drawn below the axis.
